Subject: EMEA/APAC forecast handoff + stage curation request

Team / Emma —

Quick note to kick off our week: Finance has asked for a cleaned, region-split commit view for EMEA and APAC so they can finalize the May rolling forecast. We need the following by EOD Friday 2027-05-14 so FP&A can run sensitivity scenarios: 

- Confirm committed deals (stage = Contract Sent / Verbal Commit) and provide an expected close date.
- Move any aged opportunities (in Negotiation for >120 days) back to review with a one-line reason.
- Flag deals with legal/procurement blockers and include the owner.

I've attached the current snapshot to start from (EMEA_pipeline_snapshot_May08.xlsx). Emma/Hugo — if you can confirm which legal approval dates count for your procurement timeline that helps us set realistic closes.

Deliverables: a single sheet per region (EMEA / APAC) with one row per deal and columns for: deal_id, rep, ARR, stage, expected_close, blocker (if any), next_step_owner.

I'll coordinate rollup on Friday afternoon. Ping me if any region needs more time.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of EMEA GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: EMEA_pipeline_snapshot_May08.xlsx (spreadsheet, 132KB)

Laura — thanks, noted. I started a quick pass and have a few clarifications before we lock the sheet: 

1) For pipeline age, are we using 'last activity' or 'stage entry' as the timer? I recommend stage entry to avoid churn from recent touches.
2) For legal blockers, should we list the last submitted PO/contract date or just "awaiting signature"? FP&A prefers a date so they can model timing.

Tentative plan from me: I'll produce a per-country tab for EMEA and an APAC rollup tab. I'll also attach a short notes PDF with deals I'm recommending to be moved out of commit (rishi_stage_notes.pdf).

Preliminary commitments (from my quick pass):
- DEAL-9234 | 210k ARR | stage: Verbal Commit | exp_close: 2027-05-20 | comment: awaiting legal TS | owner: Rishi
- DEAL-9981 | 85k ARR | stage: Negotiation (150+ days) | rec: move to review | owner: Marissa

I'll push my first draft by Wednesday 2027-05-12 COB.

Rishi
Senior Account Director, EMEA
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rishi_stage_notes.pdf (2 pages)
